criteria.title: Proposed: pinned guide is complete enough to author
criteria.startingState: Proposed. Branch tip commit c3d23a499f3f28806de6d335d673dd04ef487045 contains delivery and reusable-delivery-model copies of DELIVERY.md and VALIDATION.md. Bodies were not fully compared here. NOT RUN.
actions: Resolve the branch guide at the pinned commit and list the route, story template, and any templates it requires.
Record missing or incomplete required files without substituting another repository silently.
criteria.expectedResult: The pinned guide can be resolved, and any missing template or route content is reported as a gap. A story can be authored from what is present, or the gap is explicit. NOT RUN.

criteria.title: Proposed: migrate existing work without invented facts
criteria.startingState: Proposed. This local transfer is documentation only. NOT RUN as a formal check.
actions: Follow the migrate route on an existing piece of work using the pinned guide.
Confirm unknown owners and unverified results stay explicit, and that GitHub and ClickUp are unchanged unless a later explicit yes authorizes a write.
criteria.expectedResult: Existing work can be migrated into the story format without inventing owners, results, or unauthorized writes. NOT RUN.

criteria.title: Proposed: relationship to Reusable-Delivery is documented
criteria.startingState: Proposed. aispanda/Reusable-Delivery currently hosts new and migrate guides at SHA 45a5e6653f202e37f181dce8c14e6bc0d34278b7. Supersession of this branch is unverified. NOT RUN.
actions: Compare the branch delivery documents at the pinned branch commit with the Reusable-Delivery guides at the recorded SHA.
Record whether the branch is current, historical, or divergent, without merging or deleting either copy.
criteria.expectedResult: The relationship between this branch and aispanda/Reusable-Delivery is documented, and any superseded or divergent copy is labeled. NOT RUN.
